Hello Kavita,

Thank you for reaching out and sharing your concern about the timeline for your book, Raising Roots. We completely understand how important it is to have clear updates on your book's progress as you eagerly await its release.

Your book is currently in the Typesetting stage of production. For your reference, our full production path follows this sequence: Manuscript Received -> Editing (if opted) -> Cover Design -> Typesetting -> Proofreading -> ISBN Assignment -> Printing -> Distribution Setup -> Published & Live.

Our production team will follow up with you within 48 hours with more specific details regarding the next steps for your typesetting stage. 

In the meantime, please let us know if you have any additional questions.

Warm regards,
BookLeaf Support Team
